display.purpose: Hero headlines only on Persuade surfaces.

headline.purpose: Section H2 in landing; dashboard page titles.

title.purpose: Section H3, plan-card title, modal title, large list-item label.

body.purpose: Default paragraph and most UI copy.

ethiopic-display.purpose: Amharic wordmark and scoped Amharic headings.

receipt-mono.purpose: Numerals inside tariff rows, queue rows, deposit receipts.

shadows.name: pinned-notice
shadows.purpose: The single authored 'this is pinned' affordance under a hero notice or highlighted plan-card; hover adds the second layer. No other shadow exists in the system.

motion.name: receipt-print-in
motion.purpose: The telebirr deposit print-in moment; clip-path reveals the receipt from left to right.

components.name: Primary Button (Take a Number)
components.description: Deposit / commit / book action. Telebirr-green fill on bleached paper text, 2px radius, Bricolage heavy.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px 24px; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-surface-raised); font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 2px; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-deep); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button (mono outline)
components.description: Mono uppercase outline with the dashed receipt tear-line.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px 24px; border: 1px dashed var(--color-ink-rule-dashed); color: var(--color-ink); background: transparent; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 0.875rem; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Counter Button
components.description: Primary on the espresso-counter inverted band.
components.css: .ds-btn-counter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px 24px; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-surface-raised); font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-btn-counter:hover { background: var(--color-primary-deep); } .ds-btn-counter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-surface-raised); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Link
components.description: In-paragraph link; underline appears on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { color: var(--color-link); text-decoration: none; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Receipt Card
components.description: Bleached paper on cream ground, hairline ink-rule border, optional 2px telebirr ::before top rule on payment cards.
components.html:
Telebirr receipt
Lux Nails & Spa
components.css: .ds-card-receipt { position: relative; background: var(--color-surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-rule); border-radius: 2px; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-receipt__eyebrow { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--color-primary-deep); } .ds-card-receipt__title { margin-top: 0.25rem; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; }

components.name: Receipt Input (dashed underline)
components.description: Form reads like filling a receipt. Dashed tear-line underline, thickens to telebirr green on focus.
components.css: .ds-receipt-input { border: none; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-ink-rule-dashed); background: transparent; padding: 0.625rem 0.125rem; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink); outline: none; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-receipt-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink-soft) 80%, transparent); } .ds-receipt-input:focus { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-primary); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Mono uppercase inside a hairline outline. Green for success, red for warning, neutral for canvas-soft.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-rule); border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--color-ink-soft); } .ds-status--next { color: var(--color-primary-deep); border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-status--done { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-status--wait { color: var(--color-accent); border-color: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Take-a-Number Chip
components.description: The booking seriality on the queue row. Telebirr-green swatch square with receipt-mono numeral.
components.css: .ds-take-a-number { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-surface-raised); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Wordmark Stack
components.description: Heavy Amharic wordmark in Noto Serif Ethiopic above Bricolage 'Egebeya'.
components.css: .ds-wordmark__ethiopic { font-family: 'Noto Serif Ethiopic', serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem); line-height: 0.95; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-wordmark__latin { margin-top: 0.25rem; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem); letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-ink); }

puckChrome._note: Puck's outer shell (sidebar / top bar / drawer) themes to these tokens via Puck's --puck-color-* CSS variables. The canvas content stays tenant-owned; the chrome belongs to Egebeya.

narrative.northStar: The kebele noticewall — the telebirr receipt on a Qof-coffee counter.
narrative.overview: Egebeya's visual identity is the receipt Ethiopian service-business owners and their customers already trust most: the telebirr charge slip, printed on cream newsprint, signed by a green header rule and a psycho-bold mono tariff row. Around it lives the warmth of the salon counter — espresso wood, a take-a-number token, hairline dividers — the institution customers walk into for an appointment. The deposit confirms the appointment: a thing that physically becomes a receipt, designed to make that mechanism visible on a phone screen.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper ground (--color-surface = #F6F1E8) on every customer-facing area; espresso --color-canvas (#3B2820) for inverted bands only.
Telebirr green (--color-primary = #0FA958) owns 30-50% of the surface only when dramatizing the deposit-confirms-booking moment.
Hairline rules (--color-ink-rule 1px solid) instead of card shadows. Shadows exist for one narrated moment only.
Receipt-mono (JetBrains Mono) for numerals, tariffs, tx_refs, dates, slot times, status labels. Bricolage Grotesque for headlines.
Noto Serif Ethiopic for every Amharic glyph at display scale; the wordmark stack is the masthead lockup.
2px radius everywhere (--radius-card); pills exist only as rounded-full utility for genuine take-a-number chips.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The telebirr-green accent appears on <=10% of any surface that is not dramatizing the deposit-confirm-booking moment.

rules.name: The No-Blue Rule
rules.body: There is no blue in Egebeya's palette. Any blue literal (#1E3A8A, bg-blue-50) is the off-world placeholder and a defect.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Secondary text, eyebrow labels, and helper copy use --color-ink-soft (espresso-tinted) on cream and --color-canvas-soft on counter. Never text-gray-400 / text-gray-500 / text-gray-700.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Data Rule
rules.body: Any numeral that captures a tariff, an amount, a slot time, a tx_ref, a queue position, or a date stamp uses JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The Inter-Is-Not-Display Rule
rules.body: Inter never appears above 1.125rem as a heading element.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The pinned-notice shadow appears only as the authored 'this is pinned' affordance.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: backdrop-blur as decoration does not exist. Navbar's scrolled-in saturate(180%) blur(4px) is the lone exception.

dos: Do use bg-primary, bg-surface, bg-surface-raised, text-ink, text-ink-soft, border-ink-rule, bg-canvas, text-canvas-soft, text-link, focus:ring-focus Tailwind utilities (the semantic aliases in src/index.css's @theme).
Do retain the bare kebele primitives (bg-paper, bg-telebirr, font-receipt, rounded-rd-card) when the surface dramatizes the explicit Ethiopian-receipt moment.
Do pair Bricolage + Noto Serif Ethiopic + Inter + JetBrains Mono — these four faces ARE the design.
Do tint secondary text from the surface hue (--color-ink-soft on cream, --color-canvas-soft on counter), never gray.
Do reserve --color-primary green for the deposit / commit / book action and the take-a-number chip.
Do ship 2px radius (rounded-card) everywhere; deny rounded-xl / rounded-2xl / rounded-full defaults.
Do replace inputs with .receipt-input dash-underline treatment on customer-facing Booking and Settings forms.
donts: Don't use #1E3A8A (navy), #F59E0B (amber), or any Tailwind bg-blue-* / bg-amber-* / text-blue-* literal. They are off-world; the unification pass deletes them.
Don't use bg-white / bg-gray-50 / bg-gray-100 / text-gray-400 / text-gray-500 / text-gray-700 / border-gray-200 / border-gray-300. Use the kebele surface/ink-rule aliases instead.
Don't apply box-shadow defaults (shadow-sm, shadow-lg, shadow-xl). The world is flat; only the pinned-notice offset is valid.
Don't ship gradient decorations (bg-gradient-to-br, rounded-full bg-[#F59E0B]/20 blur-3xl). Gradients and blurred blobs do not exist in this world.
Don't set Inter above 1.125rem as a heading. Inter-as-display is the typo-rut of generic SaaS.
Don't use rounded-full for buttons. Pills contradict the receipt metaphor; buttons are 2px rectangles.
Don't carry the kebele canvas over to the Puck editor's canvas content — theme Puck's outer shell only.
